description:
Handwritten recipes for Bens Chocolat Supreme and Chicken with Vegs on lined paper. Verso includes drawing in ink of a belt. Annotation on verso: "Mexico / [Taxco?]"; "guerrero"; and a series of numbers and letters.

Belt sketch resembles belt worn by Georgia O'Keeffe, created by Hector Aguilar, containing "X" design.
title: Bens Chocolat Supreme and Chicken with Vegs, recipes; belt sketch
